home.title: You cannot sign in from this page
home.body: This page is only used when signing in to a website, app, or online form.
home.step1: Go back to the website, app, or form you were using.
home.step2: Select Sign in or Log in to try again.

footer.contentLicenceHtml: All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated

email.title: Enter your email address
email.errorFormat: Enter an email address in the correct format, like name@example.com

code.title: Check your email
code.sentTo: We have sent an email to: [[email]]
code.body: It might take a few minutes to arrive. The security code will expire after 15 minutes.
code.label: Enter the 6 digit security code
code.errorInvalidFormat: Enter the security code using only 6 digits
code.errorInvalid: The code you entered is not correct or has expired – enter it again or request a new code

problemsDetails.body: You can use a different email address.

phone.title: Enter your mobile phone number
phone.body: If you forget your sign-in details, we will send a 6 digit security code to the number you give us. This will allow you to get back into your form.
phone.label: Mobile phone number
phone.errorInvalid: Enter a mobile phone number in the correct format

timedOut.title: For your security, we ended your sign in
body: You have [[duration]] to finish signing in.
Go back to the service you were using and sign in again.

notFound.heading: Page not found
notFound.body1: If you typed the web address, check it is correct.
notFound.body2: If you pasted the web address, check you copied the entire address.
notFound.body3: If the web address is correct or you selected a link or button, contact the Defra Helpline if you need to speak to someone.

serverError.heading: Sorry, there is a problem with the service
serverError.contact: contact the Defra Helpline if you have any questions
